# `bill_family_archives`

**Bill-family archive listings**

One row per BILLSTATUS bulk folder, holding the listing entry the next `bill-family` run compares against before downloading that folder's zip. All columns are stored as VARCHAR.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Processing state, not published data: one row per BILLSTATUS bulk folder the `bill-family` rollup is scoped to — eight per Congress — holding the GovInfo bulkdata listing entry for that folder's zip as the last run saw it. Measured on the cold-start run of the 119th (receipt `d1-measured-run-2026-09-19/`): 8 rows, one per folder, all downloaded because no prior entry existed to compare against. The next run asks GovInfo for the folder listing and, when the entry still states the same file at the same size and stamp, skips downloading the zip entirely — the saving this table exists for is the one a cold start cannot show. It describes this pipeline's own runs, not the publisher's corpus, so no coverage range applies to it. *(measured 2026-09-19)*

**Data quality.** Only the four fields the skip compares are retained — `name` and `link`, which must name the folder's own zip or the comparison is refused outright, and `modified_at` and `size`, which must match for the zip to be skipped. The other six the publisher's listing states are deliberately absent rather than filled with guesses. All columns are stored as VARCHAR.

- **Parquet file:** `bill_family_archives.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `VARCHAR` | The zip's own file name in the folder listing, as the publisher spells it. |
| `link` | `VARCHAR` | The publisher's path to that zip; it must rebuild this folder's own locator or the skip is refused. |
| `formatted_last_modified_time` | `VARCHAR` | The publisher's own DD-Mon-YYYY HH:MM stamp string, kept as the evidence `modified_at` was read from. |
| `modified_at` | `VARCHAR` | That stamp as a UTC instant, which is one of the two values the unchanged comparison tests. |
| `size` | `VARCHAR` | The zip's byte size as the listing states it; the other value the comparison tests. |
| `congress` | `VARCHAR` | The numbered Congress whose folder this entry describes. |
| `bill_type` | `VARCHAR` | The publisher's lowercase bill-type folder name (hr, s, hjres, sjres, hconres, sconres, hres, sres). |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | When this run captured the listing the entry was read from. |
